items.title: Bloomberg Economist: ‘This Was All About Oil’ and Compares Chevron’s Venezuela Deal to 1953 Iran Coup
items.summary: A Bloomberg economist just compared Chevron's blockbuster Venezuela oil deal to a Cold War coup that looked like a triumph for 25 years before costing the U.S. one of its biggest crude suppliers almost overnight. History has a pattern here, and CVX shareholders paying a 52-week-high price may not be priced for it.
